CHAPTER ONE
GENERAL PROVISIONS
 
Article 1. Purpose of the Law
 
The purpose of this law shall be to regulate relations on Mongolian citizenship, acquisition, restoration and cessation of citizenship.
 
Article 2. Legislation on Citizenship
 
1. Legislation on citizenship shall consist of the Constitution, this law and other legislative acts enacted in conformity therewith.
2. If an international agreement to which Mongolia is a party provides otherwise than this law, then the former shall prevail.

Article 3. Mongolian Citizenship
 
1. The following persons shall be considered as citizens of Mongolia:
 
1) the persons who were citizens of Mongolia on the day of coming into force of this law;
2) the persons who were citizens of Mongolia as of 11th July 1921 and have not lost Mongolian citizenship since then.
3) a person who became a citizen of Mongolia in accordance with this Law.
2. Residing abroad of a Mongolian citizen shall not serve as a ground for loss of Mongolian citizenship.

5. Deprivation of Mongolian citizenship, exile and extradition shall be prohibited.

Article 6. Grounds for Acquisition of Mongolian Citizen
 
Mongolian citizenship shall be acquired on the following grounds:
1) by birth;
2) on acquiring Mongolian citizenship;
3) on restituting citizenship;
4) on the grounds provided for in international treaties of Mongolia.

Article 21. Request Related to Matters of Citizenship
1. A request related to matters of citizenship shall be submitted to the President of Mongolia.
A person applying for acquisition, restitution or withdrawal of Mongolian citizenship shall compile relevant documents in accordance with the list determined by procedure provided for in paragraph 6 of Article 22 of this Law.
A joint request may be submitted if an applicant wishes to acquire or withdraw Mongolian citizen

rovided for in paragraph 6 of Article 22 of this Law.
A joint request may be submitted if an applicant wishes to acquire or withdraw Mongolian citizenship together with his or her other family members.
Either parent changing citizenship shall, in respect to his or her child who has not reached the age of 16, mention in the request whether citizenship of the child is to be changed.
A request related to matters of citizenship of a child who has reached the age between 16 and 18 shall be submitted by his or her parents, guardians or sponsors upon the child's own permission and signature.

Article 24. Decisions on Matters related to Citizenship
 
The President of Mongolia shall issue decrees in case of authorizing acquisition, withdrawal or restitution of Mongolian citizenship, and orders in case of refusal.

Article 25. Determination of Date of Acquisition and Withdrawal of Citizenship
 
An applicant shall be considered as a Mongolian citizen from the date of issue of Presidential Decree on granting or restituting Mongolian citizenship.
 
An applicant shall be considered as withdrawn of Mongolian citizenship from the date of issue of Presidential Decree on withdrawal of Mongolian citizenship.
